title: Cancel UPI AutoPay in Paytm: Pause or Cancel (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel or pause a UPI AutoPay mandate in the Paytm app: open UPI & Payment Settings, go to Automatic Payments, pick the mandate and confirm.
h1: How do you cancel UPI AutoPay in the Paytm app?
summary: In the Paytm app, tap your profile icon at the top left, choose UPI & Payment Settings, then open Automatic Payments. Select the mandate and tap the cancel option at the bottom of the details screen, such as Cancel Autopay or Deactivate Mandate, and confirm, which may need your UPI PIN. Paytm's guide also describes pausing a mandate for a set period, and cancelling stops future debits but does not end your subscription with the merchant.

steps.name: Open the profile icon
steps.text: On the Paytm home screen, tap your profile icon in the top left corner.

steps.name: Choose UPI & Payment Settings
steps.text: From the menu, select UPI & Payment Settings.

steps.name: Open Automatic Payments
steps.text: Scroll down and tap Automatic Payments. Paytm's guide says some versions show Automatic UPI Payments or UPI Autopay instead.

steps.name: Select the mandate
steps.text: Tap the mandate you want to stop. The list shows the merchant name, amount and next payment date, so check them before you continue.

steps.name: Cancel or pause
steps.text: At the bottom of the details screen, look for Cancel Autopay, Deactivate Mandate or Stop Automatic Payment. Paytm's guide also describes a Pause option for a set period, which keeps the mandate active.

steps.name: Confirm and check
steps.text: Confirm the final prompt. You may be asked for your UPI PIN. Then check the mandate's status in the list.

stepsHeading: How to pause or cancel AutoPay in Paytm

sections.heading: Where Paytm keeps its automatic payments
paragraphs: Paytm's guide to deactivating UPI Autopay, last updated on 6 October 2026, gives the route as profile icon, then UPI & Payment Settings, then Automatic Payments. Mandates you approved in other UPI apps, such as Google Pay or PhonePe, usually do not appear in this list, so check those apps too.
Older versions of the app may not show the mandate options at all. If the Automatic Payments section is missing, update Paytm from the app store before you look for another route.

sections.heading: Pause or cancel: the difference
paragraphs: Paytm's guide describes Pause Autopay as a temporary suspension of deductions for a period you set. The mandate remains active and can be resumed, which suits a seasonal service or a month when you want to skip a debit.

Cancelling is different. The same guide says you would need to set up a new mandate to restart a service you have deactivated, so decide before you tap. If you only need a break, choose the pause option if your version shows it.

sections.heading: The next debit
paragraphs: Paytm's guide does not say how a debit that is already scheduled is handled. If your next payment date is close, act early, because the earlier you pause or cancel, the more likely you are to stop it. Some third-party guides say a queued debit may still go through, so check your bank statement after the date passes.
Cancelling stops future deductions only. HDFC Bank's guide to UPI AutoPay says payments already completed are not reversed, so ask the merchant directly for any refund.

sections.heading: When the change will not go through
paragraphs: If a mandate will not appear or will not change, first check which app approved it, then update Paytm. A loan or debt collection mandate may not be cancellable from the UPI app, because HDFC Bank says those mandates must be stopped with the merchant.

If Paytm will not complete the change, use the Help section in the app. The NPCI UPI Help portal at upihelp.npci.org.in is described in press coverage as a place to manage mandates across apps, but this guide could not load it to confirm its current features.

sections.heading: Stopping the subscription itself
paragraphs: Cancelling the mandate in Paytm does not end the service. Cancel the service itself in the merchant's app or website too. If the same service is billed through Google Play or the App Store, use that store's subscription settings instead.
After you have cancelled everywhere, check the mandate list again and wait for the next billing date. If no debit comes through, the stop has worked.

sections.heading: Keeping a list outside Paytm
paragraphs: Paytm's list only covers mandates approved in Paytm, so a separate list helps when you use several apps. Essara lets you add each mandate yourself, with its amount, cycle and next debit date, and shows the auto-debits due this week and this month. It does not connect to Paytm or your bank, and it cannot pause or cancel anything in Paytm for you.

faqs.q: Is pausing Paytm AutoPay the same as cancelling?
faqs.a: No. Pausing suspends deductions for a period you set, and the mandate stays active so it can be resumed. Cancelling ends future deductions, and Paytm's guide says you would need a new mandate to restart. Check which option your app shows before you choose.

faqs.q: Do I need my UPI PIN to cancel Paytm AutoPay?
faqs.a: Paytm's guide says you may be asked for your UPI PIN to authenticate the request, so keep it ready. Never share it with anyone, including someone who says they are from Paytm support.

faqs.q: Why can't I see my mandate in Automatic Payments?
faqs.a: The mandate was probably approved in a different UPI app, such as Google Pay or PhonePe. Check those apps first. If you are sure it was set up in Paytm, update the app and look again.

faqs.q: Will cancelling in Paytm refund my last payment?
faqs.a: Not by itself. Cancelling stops future deductions, and HDFC Bank's guide says completed payments are not reversed. Ask the merchant for a refund, and keep a screenshot of the mandate in case you need to raise a dispute.
